Downtown Tempe group transport, 85281

Downtown Tempe (85281) is the energetic heart of Arizona State University and the vibrant Mill Avenue entertainment district. This dynamic area combines collegiate energy with urban sophistication, featuring Tempe Town Lake, cultural venues, and a thriving restaurant and nightlife scene. Our transportation services connect students, faculty, residents, and visitors to ASU events, Sky Harbor Airport, and destinations throughout the Valley.

Neighborhood guide

Downtown Tempe pulses with energy from one of the nation's largest universities. Mill Avenue serves as the main corridor, lined with restaurants, bars, shops, and entertainment venues. Tempe Town Lake offers recreation and stunning city views, while the Tempe Center for the Arts hosts performances and events. The light rail connects downtown to Phoenix and Mesa. New high-rise developments have added modern living options, attracting young professionals alongside the student population. Game days transform the area as Sun Devil faithful fill the streets.

Frequently asked questions

Do you provide game day transportation to Sun Devil Stadium?

Yes! ASU game days are our specialty. We offer transportation to and from Sun Devil Stadium, dropping you close to the venue and picking you up after the game.

How close is Downtown Tempe to Phoenix Sky Harbor Airport?

Downtown Tempe (85281) is just 4 miles from Phoenix Sky Harbor Airport - the closest major neighborhood to PHX. Our airport transfers take approximately 10-15 minutes, making us ideal for business travelers and visitors.

Do you offer ASU graduation transportation?

We provide graduation day transportation for families visiting ASU. Our service includes airport pickups, hotel transfers, ceremony transportation, and celebration dinner shuttles.

Can you take groups to Mill Avenue nightlife?

Absolutely! Our Sprinter vans and party buses are perfect for Mill Avenue nights out. We'll transport your group safely between venues and ensure everyone gets home safely. Popular for birthday celebrations and reunions.
